doctors.title: Meet Our Specialists
doctors.subtitle: Our team of experienced doctors is dedicated to providing you with the highest quality of care.

doctor1.name: Dr. Sarah Johnson
doctor1.bio: Specialized in interventional cardiology with over 15 years of experience, Dr. Johnson has performed more than 1,000 successful cardiac procedures. She takes a patient-centered approach, focusing on preventative care and lifestyle modifications for heart health management.

doctor2.name: Dr. Mohammed Al-Farsi
doctor2.bio: Board-certified neurologist specializing in stroke treatment and prevention, Dr. Al-Farsi has extensive training in neurorehabilitation and headache management. His research on stroke recovery is published in several international medical journals.

doctor3.name: Dr. Aisha Rahman
doctor3.bio: Specialized in pediatric care with a focus on childhood development and preventive medicine, Dr. Rahman has a gentle approach that puts children at ease. She has additional training in pediatric allergy and immunology to help children with complex conditions.

doctor4.name: Dr. James Wilson
doctor4.bio: Expert in joint replacements and sports medicine with advanced surgical techniques. Dr. Wilson has worked with professional athletes and specializes in minimally invasive procedures that reduce recovery time.

doctor5.name: Dr. Fatima Al-Zahra
doctor5.bio: Specialized in treating complex eye conditions using the latest technologies and procedures. Dr. Al-Zahra has pioneered several innovative techniques for cataract surgery and is an expert in LASIK vision correction.

doctor6.name: Dr. Ahmad Khalil
doctor6.bio: Comprehensive approach to adult healthcare with expertise in chronic disease management. Dr. Khalil focuses on holistic treatment plans that address both physical and mental wellbeing for optimal health outcomes.

faq.tryDifferentSearch: Please try a different search term or browse all questions below.

appointment.question: How do I schedule an appointment?
appointment.answer: You can schedule an appointment through our online booking system, by calling our reception at +971 4 123 4567, or by visiting our medical center in person. For new patients, we recommend calling to ensure we have all the necessary information to provide you with the best care.

insurance.question: What insurance plans do you accept?
insurance.answer: We accept most major insurance plans, including Daman, Aetna, Cigna, and many others. Please contact our billing department or check our website for a complete list of accepted insurance providers. We recommend verifying your coverage before your appointment.

firstVisit.question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
firstVisit.answer: For your first visit, please bring your identification (Emirates ID or passport), insurance card, a list of any medications you're currently taking, and any relevant previous medical records or test results. Arriving 15 minutes early to complete registration forms is also recommended.

emergency.question: Do you offer emergency services?
emergency.answer: Yes, we have an emergency department that operates 24/7. For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 first. Our emergency team is equipped to handle a wide range of urgent medical situations and can coordinate with specialists as needed.

prescription.question: Can I get my prescription refilled without an appointment?
prescription.answer: For most routine prescription refills, you can request a refill through our patient portal or by calling our pharmacy directly. However, some medications may require a check-up before a refill can be authorized. Your doctor will inform you if regular appointments are necessary for your specific medication.
